data.name: Hello_Setting_Label
data.value: Also ask for Windows Hello in important approvals

data.name: Hello_Setting_Explanation
data.value: Delivering, accepting a history, giving an agent a shell or the network and changing the verification profile always ask for Windows Hello. This setting also asks for it to approve other plans, open debates, audit, accept reviews and discard work. Without Windows Hello on this computer, what always asks for it locks Windows: you unlock it with your PIN or password.

data.name: Hello_Notice_AlwaysHello
data.value: This action always asks for Windows Hello, whatever the setting says. When you approve, confirm it is you: without that, nothing is approved.

data.name: Hello_Notice_WindowsLock
data.value: This action always asks for Windows Hello, and this computer does not have it. When you approve, Windows locks: unlock it with your PIN or password. Agent Studio never sees them.

data.name: Hello_Plan_AlwaysAsks
data.value: This plan has agents or steps that write with your permissions (see the warning above). Approving it always asks for Windows Hello or, without it, locking and unlocking Windows.

data.name: Hello_Plan_ApprovedWithLock
data.value: Plan approved ({0}), confirmed by locking Windows.

data.name: Hello_Plan_LockNotConfirmed
data.value: Locking Windows did not confirm it is you ({0}): the plan is not approved.

data.name: Hello_Plan_LockNotAsked
data.value: Windows could not be locked to confirm it is you ({0}): the plan is not approved.

data.name: Hello_Approval_LockNotConfirmed
data.value: Locking Windows did not confirm it is you ({0}: {1}): denied.

data.name: Hello_Approval_LockNotAsked
data.value: Windows could not be locked to confirm it is you ({0}): denied.

data.name: Hello_SetUpHello
data.value: To approve it, set up Windows Hello: open Settings, go to Accounts and then Sign-in options, and choose a PIN, your fingerprint or your face.

data.name: Hello_LockNotComposed
data.value: this computer has no Windows Hello and the verified lock of Windows is not available

data.name: Hello_LockResult_Unlocked
data.value: you unlocked it after the request

data.name: Hello_LockResult_NotVerified
data.value: the state of the session does not confirm you unlocked it after the request

data.name: Hello_LockResult_Unknown
data.value: Windows gave a result Agent Studio does not know
